comparisons.name: window-light
comparisons.description: The whole FaceTime window against the Aqua capture, 652 by 585 pt: the dark sidebar with the window controls, the All and Missed segmented control and the empty recipient field over an empty list. Masked: the camera preview, 390 by 585 pt from x 262 (60% of the crop). The capture shows a person there and the demo an abstract placeholder that takes nothing from that picture, so there is nothing to compare. What mismatches is the sidebar's material: FaceTime's sidebar is vibrant and takes the tone of the desktop behind the window (down to #1c1c1d at the bottom right of this capture), where the demo fills it with the one opaque colour measured at its top, #413f3b. The rest is hairlines (the window's top rim, the outline the library's bezel draws around the segmented control, the field's bottom edge) and text in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: window-light-layout
comparisons.description: As window-light at the stricter threshold, with more masked, to score the frame, the sidebar's fill, the window controls, the segmented control's bezel and selected segment, and the field's bezel. Masked besides the camera preview: the two segment titles and the field's placeholder (text in the fallback font), and one rectangle of the sidebar, 142 by 165 pt at its bottom right, where the desktop behind the window shows through the capture's vibrant material and darkens it by more than the threshold; the demo's sidebar is opaque, so that patch is the capture's backdrop and not chrome. 67% of the crop is masked in all.

comparisons.name: chrome-light
comparisons.description: The measured chrome of the window, held to colours taken from the spec or computed from the tokens, with the page in Aqua: the sidebar's fill at the spec's sample points, the window's rim, the three window controls and their extent (x 8 to 60, y 5 to 17 pt), the segmented control's fill (x 64 to 198, y 32 to 51 pt, boundary at 131 pt, the selected segment's gradient and the other segment's grey), the recipient field's fill and four edges (x 11.5 to 250.5, y 60.5 to 80.5 pt) and the sidebar's end at 262 pt. The camera preview from 262 pt is demo artwork and is not read: like every comparison here it leaves the preview out. Geometry is checked to half a point at 2x. Where the library's Dark Aqua field edge is weaker than the capture's, the pixel holds the library's value and its note gives the capture's.

comparisons.name: window-dark
comparisons.description: The whole FaceTime window against the Dark Aqua capture: the same dark window as in window-light, compared and masked the same way (the camera preview, 60% of the crop). The desktop behind this capture is darker and shows through more of the sidebar (three patches, down to #1b1b1d), which is the larger mismatch.

comparisons.name: window-dark-layout
comparisons.description: As window-dark at the stricter threshold, with more masked, as in window-light-layout: the two segment titles, the field's placeholder, and the three patches of the sidebar where the desktop behind the window shows through the capture's vibrant material (two at its left edge, 38 by 136 pt and 75 by 86 pt, and the bottom right in two rectangles, 97 by 65 pt and 177 by 165 pt). 73% of the crop is masked in all.

comparisons.name: chrome-dark
comparisons.description: The window with the page in Dark Aqua: it is dark in both appearances and must not follow the page's. One pixel of each part that chrome-light holds, to the same colour: the sidebar's fill, the rim, a window control, the two segments, the field's fill and top edge, and the sidebar's end at 262 pt. The camera preview is demo artwork and is not read.
